newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar barely down, trade seen in range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar barely down, trade seen in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were slightly weaker in light midsession volume that is expected to persist through options expiry on Friday, dealers said.
Spot May is seen hoving around 11.00 cents a lb as open interest in the May 11.00 calls remains high. As of Friday, open interest was 7,635 lots.
Traders said shortcovering by the trade in the May/July spread was supporting the market, while producers were willing sellers above 11.00 cents in May.
At 1130 EDT, May was off 0.01 cent at 10.99 cents, ranged from 11.03 to 10.95 cents. The deferred months were 0.01 higher to 0.02 lower.
Volume was estimated at 5,790 lots as of 1100 EDT.
Open interest in May rose 194 lots to 60,779 lots as of Friday's close. The last trading day for the contract is April 30.
May support was pegged at Tuesday's low of 10.78 cents.
